## 1.1 click and requests {#step-01.1}

The command needs two packages that Python does not have. click makes command lines, with options and help.
requests gets pages over HTTP. `uv add` puts both in the dependencies of wikiapp, and installs them in `.venv`. It
also chooses one version of each package that fits every range of versions, and writes the versions in the
lockfile, `uv.lock`. uv calls this choice resolving.

[click](https://click.palletsprojects.com/) comes from Pallets, who also make Flask. In click, the line `@click.command()` above a
function makes the function a command. Such a line is a decorator. Each option of the command becomes a parameter of
the function. [requests](https://requests.readthedocs.io/)
is a widely used library for HTTP. One call, `requests.get`, fetches a page.

```bash
uv add click requests
```

```bash
uv tree --depth 1
```

`uv tree` shows the two packages under `wikiapp`. A newer version of a package can come out after these notes.

If your versions are newer, `uv add` writes them into `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock`. Only those versions differ
from the ones here.

`pyproject.toml` asks for a range, such as `click>=8.5.0`. `uv.lock` names the one version that uv chose, and the
versions of every package that click and requests need. Two people with the same lockfile get the same packages.

Check your files against this move. The command prints nothing when they match, and otherwise shows what differs:

```bash
git check 36d49582843a
```

If you are stuck, this command puts the files of this move in place of yours. A file that you made yourself stays:

```bash
git fetch --quiet --tags --force origin; git restore --source step-00 --staged -- :/ && git restore --source 36d49582843a --staged --worktree -- :/
```

### What changed {#step-01.1-what-changed-182c57}

- <a id="step-01.1-pyproject.toml-5d07e7"></a>`pyproject.toml`: the dependencies of the package, which anyone who installs it gets. 4 lines added, 1 removed. It comes from `uv add click requests`. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/smallwikiapp/blob/36d49582843a575d84ed178ad66157913be4c59c/pyproject.toml){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}
  - look at `"click>=8.5.0",`
- <a id="step-01.1-uv.lock-8356d8"></a>`uv.lock`: the exact versions, for every platform. 176 lines added. It comes from `uv add click requests`. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/smallwikiapp/blob/36d49582843a575d84ed178ad66157913be4c59c/uv.lock){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}

<a id="step-01.1-pyproject.toml-5d07e7-diff"></a>

<details><summary>The diff that <code>uv add click requests</code> makes in <code>pyproject.toml</code></summary>

```diff
@@ -7,7 +7,10 @@ license = "Apache-2.0"
 license-files = ["LICENSE"]
 authors = [{ name = "Rahul Dave" }]
 requires-python = ">=3.13"
-dependencies = []
+dependencies = [
+    "click>=8.5.0",
+    "requests>=2.34.2",
+]
 
 [project.scripts]
 wikiapp = "wikiapp.console:main"
```

</details>
